text:
jessica_sales: Heads-up — Acme POC can't finish onboarding. SCIM sync fails with 400 when creating users, and their SAML assertion isn't providing email so accounts end up empty. Need help coordinating with IdP.

marco_se: @irma_idp_admin can you confirm which attribute your IdP is sending for email? We expect 'email' or NameID=email. Also need group membership for RBAC mapping. :thinking:

irma_idp_admin: We're sending `mail` as the attribute. NameID is persistent-id by default. I can change NameID but want to avoid breaking other apps. SCIM token already configured on our side but the user payload looks like it's missing 'userName' field.

jessica_sales: Acme is using Okta. Our SCIM service expects `userName` to be the user's primary email. If NameID != email we still rely on SCIM to provision the account. Error snippet from their logs: 
```
HTTP 400 Bad Request - missing required attribute 'userName'
{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Error" ], "detail": "attribute 'userName' is required" }
```

marco_se: Ok — two parallel fixes: (1) update Okta SCIM mapping to send `userName` -> user.email, and (2) for SAML set NameID format to `emailAddress` or add attribute `email`. Example SAML mapping we recommend: 
```
<NameIDPolicy Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress"/>
<Attribute Name="email" NameFormat="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:attrname-format:basic">
  <AttributeValue>${user.email}</AttributeValue>
</Attribute>
<Attribute Name="groups">${user.groups}</Attribute>
```

irma_idp_admin: I can update the mappings. One question: do we need to send groups as a CSV or multiple attributes?

daniel_security: For RBAC we accept groups either as a multi-valued attribute or a single string CSV. If sending CSV, use `,` and avoid spaces. Also please set SCIM to send `active` boolean. We use that to deactivate accounts automatically.

jessica_sales: FYI Dedicated pool assignment is blocked until accounts are provisioned. I submitted a request to infra — deploy-bot should create the pool once we confirm IdP mappings.

deploy-bot: [system] Dedicated pool request for acme-poc queued (req-4983). Will provision after user list confirmed.

marco_se: Quick checklist for IdP team: 
- SCIM: map userName -> user.email, set active -> true/false, include name/givenName/familyName
- SAML: NameID=emailAddress OR attribute 'email' present, include 'groups' attribute
- Send test user payload via curl to our SCIM sandbox endpoint: 
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://scim.redwood.ai/v2/Users -d '{"userName":"test@acme.com","name":{"givenName":"Test","familyName":"User"},"active":true}'
```

irma_idp_admin: I'll run the test and post results here in ~30m. Thanks for the sample.

jessica_sales: Also note: for Hosted API key access during the POC, we can generate a scoped API key for them to use immediately if SCIM delay persists — limited to test env only. Want me to generate?

irma_idp_admin: Please do, that would help unblock devs.

marco_se: I'll generate a short-lived hosted key and DM it to your SRE contact. Reminder: keys are for testing only, not for production Dedicated access.

jessica_sales: Great. I'll keep this thread updated. If IdP tests fail paste the raw response (sanitized) and we can escalate with engineering. :thumbsup:
